connector.name: Ravendb MCP
connector.registryDescription: Read-only MCP diagnostics server for RavenDB.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the NuGet package RavenDB.Mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ravendb account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: RAVENDB_URLS
env.description: Comma-separated RavenDB node URLs of a single cluster, e.g. https://a.example:443,https://b.example:443

env.name: RAVENDB_CERTIFICATE_PATH
env.description: Path to a client .pfx certificate for secured RavenDB. Leave empty for unsecured.

env.name: RAVENDB_ARTIFACTS_PATH
env.description: Directory where exported artifacts (logs, packages, dumps) are written.
